nodes.long_description:
[EASY]
One type appears once each time.

[NORMAL]
Two types appear alternately.

[HARD]
Two types appear simultaneously.
nodes.short_description: It is a cognitive game for cognitive rehabilitation training to help rehabilitate people with cognitive decline and mild cognitive impairment, and is designed to provide two or more cognitive experiences and training in the game. Grip Mission: Category Quest is designed to allow people with disabilities who have difficulty using controllers to play games through hand tracking.
